description: Stablecoin supply from DefiLlama. Returns totals_usd_pegged {circulating, change_1d, change_7d, change_30d} in USD, depegged_over_50bps[] (USD stablecoins trading below $0.995 with ≥ $50M supply: symbol, price, depeg_bps, circulating), and items[] per stablecoin (symbol, peg, mechanism, price, circulating, change_1d/7d/30d, change_7d_pct, change_30d_pct, chains), sorted by supply. Net new supply is a proxy for fresh on-chain dollar liquidity. $0.002/call. Use for total stablecoin supply and net change; for individual large transfers use whale_moves.

limit.description: How many stablecoins in items[], default 25
